notes.title: Update Note for Version 1.8.0 Update
notes.content:
hello everyone.
We're sorry for being late for the update.

Here are the contents of version 1.8.0:
1、 Adjust five levels of the country of light and add one level
2、 Added the story of the queen of the country of light;
3、 Fixed the problem that the game could not run because of the system environment;
4. Fix the problem that the turntable cannot run because of the system environment.

The next update is expected in September.
Have a nice game.
